sources.title: Splendor Produce — blackberry names in the August 2011 company interview
sources.enumerated_scope: The three literal blackberry names in the company interview’s answer about its main varieties, PDF page 35. Issue date verified on PDF page 3.
sources.limitations: Historical production interview, not a current portfolio or breeding/rights record. Printed spellings are retained without accepting aliases to Tupy, Brazos or any other catalog name. The neighboring Driscoll text and generic, uncaptained fruit photographs do not identify these varieties. Regional acreage/export figures are outside this name-list scope. No current supply, trait, legal right or growing region is approved. The 2024 upload directory is not the publication date.
review_warnings: August 2011 interview: current varieties and supply still need checking.
